description: Invite someone into the organization by email, with a role: owner (admin), manager, member or viewer. Confirm address AND role with your user before calling — an invite grants real access. The result reports honestly whether the invite email was queued; when it wasn't (no email configured, delivery failure), the invite still exists — tell your user to share the invite link from the app's Members page. A live pending invite for the same address is rejected (invitePending), so a retry never duplicates. Admin only.

role.description: Role in the organization — owner is the admin role

name: create_invite

emailQueued.description: True = the invite email was handed to the provider

note.description: Present when no email went out — share the link from the app

title: Invite member
